name: Southern Plains Grassland Program
summary: Grants for on-the-ground grassland conservation in the Southern Great Plains: improved grazing management, grassland restoration, woody invasive removal and fence modification for wildlife.

geography.label: Southern Great Plains (eastern Colorado to the Texas Panhandle)

reporting: Applicants pick the most relevant project metrics from the programme's list in NFWF's Easygrants system for future reporting.

status.quote: Southern Plains Grassland Program 2026 Request for Proposals - CLOSED

deadline.quote: Full Proposal Due Date Thursday, November 13, 2025, 11:59 PM ET

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include non-profit 501(c) organizations, U.S. Federal government agencies, rancher and community-led organizations, educational institutions, Native Nations and Indigenous-led organizations, and state or local units of governments

geography.quote: Projects in the following areas are eligible for Southern Plains Grasslands support: Eastern Colorado, Kansas, Southern Nebraska, Northeastern New Mexico, Oklahoma, and the Texas Panhandle.

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

window.quote: Full Proposal Due Date Thursday, November 13, 2025, 11:59 PM ET

amount.quote: Individual grants typically range from $150,000 to $400,000.

co_finance_required.quote: A minimum match requirement of 1:1 is required and will be considered in application review.

reporting.quote: the Southern Plains Grassland Program has a list of metrics in Easygrants for full proposal applicants to choose from for future reporting
